title: Watch Mark Zuckerberg, Steve Jobs, and other famous tech CEOs transform from children to adults in these creepy, mesmerizing animations (AAPL, MSFT, TSLA, FB)
text: Watch Mark Zuckerberg, Steve Jobs, and other famous tech CEOs transform from children to adults in these creepy, mesmerizing animations (AAPL, MSFT, TSLA, FB) By Avery Hartmans Apr 27, 2018, 2:56 pm 5 pts It's weirdly mesmerizing to watch the best-known tech CEOs of all time get older before your very eyes. The team at Empire Flippers, a company that buys and sells websites, put together the GIFs to show how some of the most well-known people in tech have transformed over the years. The GIFs show…
